d:
Bihar ko sirph itihas men mat khojie… uski aastha men bhi utrie.
Ganga ki pavitr dharaon, prachin bhu-drishyon aur lokjivan ki sahaj aastha ke bich bihar men shiv upasna ki paranpra sadiyon se jivant rahi hai. isi aadhyatmik virasat ko ek vyapak yatra anubhav men pirone ki disha men shiv sarkit ek mahatvapurn pahal hai.
